title: Motivational talk: learn to talk to strangers (say hi, ask small questions) as a life/business skill; no AI or tooling content
claims: Being comfortable approaching strangers is a 'gold mine' skill for business, friendships and love
Even negative interactions give dopamine and stories; discomfort never fully goes away
how_to_steps: Start micro: say hi to people
Ask low-stakes questions (are those chicken nuggets good? how long has this light been running?)
Practice the muscle without needing anything in exchange
Say hi in the comments or smile at someone nearby right now
